# Plan: chore: add JSDoc to debounce utility in utils.js

## Task Description
The `debounce` function in `web-components/src/utils.js` is missing a JSDoc comment block. Other exported utilities in the same file — `createTag`, `isMobileOrTablet`, `discoverService`, `paramsToHash` — already have JSDoc. Adding a matching block to `debounce` restores consistency and helps contributors understand its parameters and return type.

No functional changes are required.

## Relevant Files
- `web-components/src/utils.js` — contains the `debounce` function to annotate (line 5)

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add JSDoc block to `debounce`
- Insert a JSDoc comment immediately above `export function debounce(func, delay)` matching the style of `createTag`
- Document `@param {Function} func` — the function to debounce
- Document `@param {number} delay` — delay in milliseconds
- Document `@returns {Function}` — the debounced wrapper function

## Acceptance Criteria
- `debounce` in `web-components/src/utils.js` has a JSDoc block with `@param` and `@returns` tags matching the style of `createTag`
- No functional changes to the implementation
- `node --check web-components/src/utils.js` passes
